title: Abstraction versus encapsulation
answer: Abstraction focuses on what a component promises to do while hiding unnecessary implementation details behind a contract. Encapsulation focuses on protecting an object's internal state and controlling access to that state through a defined boundary. In AeroTopo, `Product.resolutionMetres()` is an abstraction because callers depend on the operation without knowing how each subtype computes it. The private `id`, `tiles`, and `gsd` fields demonstrate encapsulation because their representation is hidden and updated only through controlled construction and methods.
